Overview.Name: Satish Koleti
Overview.Goal: Reduce body fat, look leaner, improve energy levels and overall health while keeping meals simple and sustainable.

Meal_1_Main_Meal: Paneer pan fried in ghee + vegetable curry (bottle gourd, ridge gourd or beans)
OR Thick curd bowl + cooked vegetables
OR Paneer curry + small portion plain rice
OR Vegetable dal + plain rice + rasam
Meal_2_Second_Meal: OR Curd rice (small portion) + cooked vegetables

Notes_and_Tips: Prioritise paneer, curd and dal in every meal to support fat loss and muscle maintenance.
Keep rice portions small and avoid biryani and heavy mixed dishes during regular days.
Use ghee for cooking instead of refined oils.
Since social gatherings trigger overeating, eat a paneer or curd-based meal before attending.
Stick to simple, repetitive meals on busy days to avoid overeating.
Aim to maintain 7,000–8,000 steps daily for better fat loss and digestion.
Finish dinner at least 2–3 hours before sleep for better recovery.
Stay well hydrated with water and buttermilk through the day.
Consistency with simple meals will visibly reduce belly fat and improve overall physique.
